en: Black‑and‑white image showing a powerful, terraced waterfall viewed from below, with foaming water rushing toward the camera. In the background there appears to be a wooden structure, possibly a bridge or flume, crossing above the falls. Trees line the sides of the river. In the lower left corner, white printed caption text reads "Fallet vid Rottneros," indicating the waterfall near Rottneros.
